crossRefs.note: They hatch adders’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks…
Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and…

translations.web: Whose confidence will break apart, Whose trust is a spider’s web.
translations.bsb: His confidence is fragile; his security is in a spider’s web.
translations.kjv: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider's web.
translations.asv: Whose confidence shall break in sunder, And whose trust is a spider's web.
